title: NAVER SPLADE official implementation, research and exact checkpoint licensing
evidence_note: Learned vocabulary weighting/expansion supports inverted-index retrieval. Official repository LICENSE is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; exact cocondenser-ensembledistil and splade-v3 cards declare the same license. SPLADE-v3 shows a contact-sharing access gate.
limitation: These exact artifacts are noncommercial, not unrestricted open-source releases. Sparsity/effectiveness research does not establish CPU latency or governing-evidence completeness in this study. No gated access requested.
review_level: Official README architecture/indexing sections and LICENSE; SPLADE++ paper sections 3-4; exact publisher model cards and public API revision/license/access metadata. No weights downloaded or code executed.

title: OpenSearch document-only learned sparse checkpoint and primary paper
evidence_note: Exact doc-v2-distill card uses learned document encoding and query token presence multiplied by supplied IDF weights. Non-doc v2-distill encodes both queries and documents. Both cards declare Apache-2.0 and link official neural-search LICENSE.
limitation: Inference-free means no learned neural query pass, not zero query cost. Paper experiment uses BERT-base, so its measurements cannot automatically be attributed to the exact 67M DistilBERT checkpoint. No local test or index build performed.
review_level: Exact publisher cards, query/document examples, LICENSE link and API revisions reviewed. Independent source check inspected paper v2 methods sections 3-4, setup/relevance/efficiency/IDF sections 5.1-5.4. No weights downloaded.

title: Sentence Transformers semantic-search documentation and exact dense baseline
evidence_note: Documents precomputed corpus embeddings, per-query embedding and similarity search; explains asymmetric retrieval and approximate-search misses. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 card describes 384-dimensional vectors, short-paragraph use and default 256-word-piece truncation.
limitation: General embedding checkpoint is a proposed baseline, not evidence of best asymmetric memory retrieval. ANN introduces a recall tradeoff. CPU latency and correction-sensitive recall need local execution.
review_level: Official background, symmetric/asymmetric, manual search and ANN sections; model card license/intended use; official framework LICENSE and public API checkpoint revision inspected. No weights downloaded.

title: ColBERTv2 and PLAID official implementation, query/index boundary and update API
evidence_note: Stores token-level passage vectors; query encoding and MaxSim occur at search. PLAID adds centroid filtering and optimized kernels. Official README supports CPU execution but requires GPU training/indexing. Updater exposes add/remove/persist, with application-owned source mapping.
limitation: Published server/thread measurements are not desktop speed guarantees. Updater is marked beta in README and is not a filesystem correction detector or atomic version-policy implementation. No index or query was executed.
review_level: README architecture, installation, indexing/search/update notices; MIT code license and exact model card; PLAID methods section 4, setup/hardware section 5.1 and evaluation limits; updater public methods/source inspected.

title: OpenSearch official hybrid ranking and exact-term field semantics
evidence_note: Official docs describe lexical/semantic hybrid search, score normalization versus reciprocal rank fusion, and pre/post filtering. Exact-term guidance warns that analyzed text fields can fail literal matches.
limitation: Documents an available mechanism, not a recommendation to add a cluster or proof that fusion/filters preserve governing context. Authored metadata rules in the research note are prospective policies, not validated truth extraction.

title: scikit-learn supervised decision trees and code licensing
evidence_note: DecisionTreeClassifier fits feature arrays with supplied class labels. Official docs describe depth-dependent inference, overfitting, instability and class imbalance. Source code license is BSD-3-Clause.
limitation: No pretrained personal filing classifier is supplied. Labels, features, unknown handling, thresholds and held-out validation would be new work. Fast traversal does not make feature extraction free or scores authoritative.
review_level: Supervised overview, classification input/output, complexity and practical limitations sections; full short COPYING license inspected. No fitting, dependencies or labels added.
